parakeet: I don't debate Christians, not because I'm scared of what they believe, but because I know where those beliefs come from. I know the source material, I know the tactics, I know how the stage is set, and I refuse to validate a magic trick just because the audience believes in it. This isn't arrogance, it's alignment. It's recognizing that a bad premise doesn't deserve a good platform. And that saying no to delusion isn't closed-minded, it's clarity. So if you've ever been told that declining to debate means you're afraid, or that you owe religion the courtesy of a seat at every table, this video is for you. Because sometimes the most responsible thing you can do with the myth is walk away from the performance.
